verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.he: אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בְעֹור־בְּשָׂרֹו֙ שְׂאֵ֤ת אֹֽו־סַפַּ֙חַת֙ אֹ֣ו בַהֶ֔רֶת וְהָיָ֥ה בְעֹור־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו לְנֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת וְהוּבָא֙ אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֹ֛ו אֶל־אַחַ֥ד מִבָּנָ֖יו הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.ar: «إِذَا كَانَ إِنْسَانٌ فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ نَاتِئٌ أَوْ قُوبَاءُ أَوْ لُمْعَةٌ تَصِيرُ فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ ضَرْبَةَ بَرَصٍ، يُؤْتَى بِهِ إِلَى هَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ أَوْ إِلَى أَحَدِ بَنِيهِ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ.
verses.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests.
verses.kjv: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh [like] the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.web: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֣גַע בְּעֹֽור־הַ֠בָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָ֨ר בַּנֶּ֜גַע הָפַ֣ךְ ׀ לָבָ֗ן וּמַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמֹק֙ מֵעֹ֣ור בְּשָׂרֹ֔ו נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְרָאָ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטִמֵּ֥א אֹתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلضَّرْبَةَ فِي جِلْدِ ٱلْجَسَدِ، وَفِي ٱلضَّرْبَةِ شَعَرٌ قَدِ ٱبْيَضَّ، وَمَنْظَرُ ٱلضَّرْبَةِ أَعْمَقُ مِنْ جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ، فَهِيَ ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ. فَمَتَى رَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ يَحْكُمُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague in the skin of the flesh; and if the hair in the plague be turned white, and the appearance of the plague be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and [when] the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight [be] deeper than the skin of his flesh, it [is] a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.web: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם־בַּהֶרֶת֩ לְבָנָ֨ה הִ֜וא בְּעֹ֣ור בְּשָׂרֹ֗ו וְעָמֹק֙ אֵין־מַרְאֶ֣הָ מִן־הָעֹ֔ור וּשְׂעָרָ֖ה לֹא־הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَتِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ لُمْعَةً بَيْضَاءَ فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْظَرُهَا أَعْمَقَ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَلَمْ يَبْيَضَّ شَعْرُهَا، يَحْجُزُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْمَضْرُوبَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
verses.en: And if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days.
verses.kjv: If the bright spot [be] white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight [be] not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague seven days:
verses.web: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵן֮ בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמַ֣ד בְּעֵינָ֔יו לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּעֹ֑ור וְהִסְגִּירֹ֧ו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ وَإِذَا فِي عَيْنِهِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ قَدْ وَقَفَتْ، وَلَمْ تَمْتَدَّ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، يَحْجُزُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ ثَانِيَةً.
verses.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague stay in its appearance, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, [if] the plague in his sight be at a stay, [and] the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.web: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

verses.he: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֹתֹ֜ו בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּעֹ֑ור וְטִהֲרֹ֤ו הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔יא וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ ثَانِيَةً وَإِذَا ٱلضَّرْبَةُ كَامِدَةُ ٱللَّوْنِ، وَلَمْ تَمْتَدَّ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِطَهَارَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا حَزَازٌ. فَيَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَكُونُ طَاهِرًا.
verses.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague be dim, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is a scab; and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, [if] the plague [be] somewhat dark, [and] the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it [is but] a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.web: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֨ה תִפְשֶׂ֤ה הַמִּסְפַּ֙חַת֙ בָּעֹ֔ור אַחֲרֵ֧י הֵרָאֹתֹ֛ו אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְטָהֳרָתֹ֑ו וְנִרְאָ֥ה שֵׁנִ֖ית אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَتِ ٱلْقُوبَاءُ تَمْتَدُّ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ بَعْدَ عَرْضِهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ لِتَطْهِيرِهِ، يُعْرَضُ عَلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ ثَانِيَةً.
verses.en: But if the scab spread abroad in the skin, after that he hath shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
verses.kjv: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.web: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

verses.he: וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשְׂתָ֥ה הַמִּסְפַּ֖חַת בָּעֹ֑ור וְטִמְּאֹ֥ו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן צָרַ֥עַת הִֽוא׃ פ
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلْقُوبَاءُ قَدِ ٱمْتَدَّتْ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا بَرَصٌ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look, and, behold, if the scab be spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.
verses.kjv: And [if] the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a leprosy.
verses.web: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

verses.he: נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאָדָ֑ם וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: «إِنْ كَانَتْ فِي إِنْسَانٍ ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ فَيُؤْتَى بِهِ إِلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest.
verses.kjv: ¶ When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.web: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־לְבָנָה֙ בָּעֹ֔ור וְהִ֕יא הָפְכָ֖ה שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֑ן וּמִֽחְיַ֛ת בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י בַּשְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ نَاتِئٌ أَبْيَضُ، قَدْ صَيَّرَ ٱلشَّعْرَ أَبْيَضَ، وَفِي ٱلنَّاتِئِ وَضَحٌ مِنْ لَحْمٍ حَيٍّ،
verses.en: And the priest shall look, and, behold, if there be a white rising in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising,
verses.kjv: And the priest shall see [him:] and, behold, [if] the rising [be] white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and [there be] quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.web: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

verses.he: צָרַ֨עַת נֹושֶׁ֤נֶת הִוא֙ בְּעֹ֣ור בְּשָׂרֹ֔ו וְטִמְּאֹ֖ו הַכֹּהֵ֑ן לֹ֣א יַסְגִּרֶ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: فَهُوَ بَرَصٌ مُزْمِنٌ فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ. فَيَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. لَا يَحْجُزُهُ لِأَنَّهُ نَجِسٌ.
verses.en: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean; he shall not shut him up; for he is unclean.
verses.kjv: It [is] an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he [is] unclean.
verses.web: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּרֹ֨וחַ תִּפְרַ֤ח הַצָּרַ֙עַת֙ בָּעֹ֔ור וְכִסְּתָ֣ה הַצָּרַ֗עַת אֵ֚ת כָּל־עֹ֣ור הַנֶּ֔גַע מֵרֹאשֹׁ֖ו וְעַד־רַגְלָ֑יו לְכָל־מַרְאֵ֖ה עֵינֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْبَرَصُ قَدْ أَفْرَخَ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَغَطَّى ٱلْبَرَصُ كُلَّ جِلْدِ ٱلْمَضْرُوبِ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ إِلَى قَدَمَيْهِ حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا تَرَاهُ عَيْنَا ٱلْكَاهِنِ،
verses.en: And if the leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his feet, as far as appeareth to the priest;
verses.kjv: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.web: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֨ה כִסְּתָ֤ה הַצָּרַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂרֹ֔ו וְטִהַ֖ר אֶת־הַנָּ֑גַע כֻּלֹּ֛ו הָפַ֥ךְ לָבָ֖ן טָהֹ֥ור הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَرَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلْبَرَصُ قَدْ غَطَّى كُلَّ جِسْمِهِ، يَحْكُمُ بِطَهَارَةِ ٱلْمَضْرُوبِ. كُلُّهُ قَدِ ٱبْيَضَّ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ.
verses.en: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague; it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, [if] the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: it is all turned white: he [is] clean.
verses.web: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

verses.he: וּבְיֹ֨ום הֵרָאֹ֥ות בֹּ֛ו בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ يَوْمَ يُرَى فِيهِ لَحْمٌ حَيٌّ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا.
verses.en: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.kjv: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.web: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֖י וְטִמְּאֹ֑ו הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֛י טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא צָרַ֥עַת הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: فَمَتَى رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱللَّحْمَ ٱلْحَيَّ يَحْكُمُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. ٱللَّحْمُ ٱلْحَيُّ نَجِسٌ. إِنَّهُ بَرَصٌ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean; the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: [for] the raw flesh [is] unclean: it [is] a leprosy.
verses.web: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

verses.he: אֹ֣ו כִ֥י יָשׁ֛וּב הַבָּשָׂ֥ר הַחַ֖י וְנֶהְפַּ֣ךְ לְלָבָ֑ן וּבָ֖א אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ ٱللَّحْمُ ٱلْحَيُّ وَٱبْيَضَّ يَأْتِي إِلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.en: But if the raw flesh again be turned into white, then he shall come unto the priest;
verses.kjv: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.web: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ הַנֶּ֖גַע לְלָבָ֑ן וְטִהַ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע טָהֹ֥ור הֽוּא׃ פ
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلضَّرْبَةُ قَدْ صَارَتْ بَيْضَاءَ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِطَهَارَةِ ٱلْمَضْرُوبِ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ.
verses.en: and the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the plague be turned into white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, [if] the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: he [is] clean.
verses.web: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

verses.he: וּבָשָׂ֕ר כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בֹֽו־בְעֹרֹ֖ו שְׁחִ֑ין וְנִרְפָּֽא׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَ ٱلْجِسْمُ فِي جِلْدِهِ دُمَّلَةٌ قَدْ بَرِئَتْ،
verses.en: And when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a boil, and it is healed,
verses.kjv: ¶ The flesh also, in which, [even] in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.web: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

verses.he: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְקֹ֤ום הַשְּׁחִין֙ שְׂאֵ֣ת לְבָנָ֔ה אֹ֥ו בַהֶ֖רֶת לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדָּ֑מֶת וְנִרְאָ֖ה אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَصَارَ فِي مَوْضِعِ ٱلدُّمَّلَةِ نَاتِئٌ أَبْيَضُ، أَوْ لُمْعَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ ضَارِبَةٌ إِلَى ٱلْحُمْرَةِ، يُعْرَضُ عَلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.en: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.kjv: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.web: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֶ֙הָ֙ שָׁפָ֣ל מִן־הָעֹ֔ור וּשְׂעָרָ֖הּ הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְטִמְּאֹ֧ו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן נֶֽגַע־צָרַ֥עַת הִ֖וא בַּשְּׁחִ֥ין פָּרָֽחָה׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا مَنْظَرُهَا أَعْمَقُ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ وَقَدِ ٱبْيَضَّ شَعْرُهَا، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ أَفْرَخَتْ فِي ٱلدُّمَّلَةِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy, it hath broken out in the boil.
verses.kjv: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it [be] in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.web: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם ׀ יִרְאֶ֣נָּה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־בָּהּ֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּשְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛נָּה מִן־הָעֹ֖ור וְהִ֣יא כֵהָ֑ה וְהִסְגִּירֹ֥ו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ رَآهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَعْرٌ أَبْيَضُ، وَلَيْسَتْ أَعْمَقَ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَهِيَ كَامِدَةُ ٱللَّوْنِ، يَحْجُزُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and it be not lower than the skin, but be dim, then the priest shall shut him up seven days.
verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, [there be] no white hairs therein, and [if] it [be] not lower than the skin, but [be] somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.web: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֥ה תִפְשֶׂ֖ה בָּעֹ֑ור וְטִמֵּ֧א הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתֹ֖ו נֶ֥גַע הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ كَانَتْ قَدِ ٱمْتَدَّتْ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا ضَرْبَةٌ.
verses.en: And if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.kjv: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a plague.
verses.web: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

verses.he: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּ֜יהָ תַּעֲמֹ֤ד הַבַּהֶ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א פָשָׂ֔תָה צָרֶ֥בֶת הַשְּׁחִ֖ין הִ֑וא וְטִהֲרֹ֖ו הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ ס
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ وَقَفَتِ ٱللُّمْعَةُ مَكَانَهَا وَلَمْ تَمْتَدَّ، فَهِيَ أَثَرُ ٱلدُّمَّلَةِ. فَيَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِطَهَارَتِهِ.
verses.en: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.kjv: But if the bright spot stay in his place, [and] spread not, it [is] a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.web: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.he: אֹ֣ו בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְעֹרֹ֖ו מִכְוַת־אֵ֑שׁ וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה מִֽחְיַ֣ת הַמִּכְוָ֗ה בַּהֶ֛רֶת לְבָנָ֥ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֖מֶת אֹ֥ו לְבָנָֽה׃
verses.ar: «أَوْ إِذَا كَانَ ٱلْجِسْمُ فِي جِلْدِهِ كَيُّ نَارٍ، وَكَانَ حَيُّ ٱلْكَيِّ لُمْعَةً بَيْضَاءَ ضَارِبَةً إِلَى ٱلْحُمْرَةِ أَوْ بَيْضَاءَ،
verses.en: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick flesh of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;
verses.kjv: ¶ Or if there be [any] flesh, in the skin whereof [there is] a hot burning, and the quick [flesh] that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.web: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה אֹתָ֣הּ הַכֹּהֵ֡ן וְהִנֵּ֣ה נֶהְפַּךְ֩ שֵׂעָ֨ר לָבָ֜ן בַּבַּהֶ֗רֶת וּמַרְאֶ֙הָ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָעֹ֔ור צָרַ֣עַת הִ֔וא בַּמִּכְוָ֖ה פָּרָ֑חָה וְטִמֵּ֤א אֹתֹו֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: وَرَآهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلشَّعْرُ فِي ٱللُّمْعَةِ قَدِ ٱبْيَضَّ، وَمَنْظَرُهَا أَعْمَقُ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، فَهِيَ بَرَصٌ قَدْ أَفْرَخَ فِي ٱلْكَيِّ. فَيَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ.
verses.en: then the priest shall look upon it; and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, it is leprosy, it hath broken out in the burning; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, [if] the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it [be in] sight deeper than the skin; it [is] a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] the plague of leprosy.
verses.web: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם ׀ יִרְאֶ֣נָּה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־בַּבֶּהֶ֙רֶת֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּשְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛נָּה מִן־הָעֹ֖ור וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֑ה וְהִסְגִּירֹ֥ו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ رَآهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا لَيْسَ فِي ٱللُّمْعَةِ شَعْرٌ أَبْيَضُ، وَلَيْسَتْ أَعْمَقَ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَهِيَ كَامِدَةُ ٱللَّوْنِ، يَحْجُزُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ،
verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days.
verses.kjv: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, [there be] no white hair in the bright spot, and it [be] no lower than the [other] skin, but [be] somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.web: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י אִם־פָּשֹׂ֤ה תִפְשֶׂה֙ בָּעֹ֔ור וְטִמֵּ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתֹ֔ו נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת הִֽוא׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَرَاهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ. فَإِنْ كَانَتْ قَدِ ٱمْتَدَّتْ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day; if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: [and] if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] the plague of leprosy.
verses.web: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

verses.he: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּיהָ֩ תַעֲמֹ֨ד הַבַּהֶ֜רֶת לֹא־פָשְׂתָ֤ה בָעֹור֙ וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֔ה שְׂאֵ֥ת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְטִֽהֲרֹו֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן כִּֽי־צָרֶ֥בֶת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ פ
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ وَقَفَتِ ٱللُّمْعَةُ مَكَانَهَا، لَمْ تَمْتَدَّ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَكَانَتْ كَامِدَةَ ٱللَّوْنِ، فَهِيَ نَاتِئُ ٱلْكَيِّ، فَٱلْكَاهِنُ يَحْكُمُ بِطَهَارَتِهِ لِأَنَّهَا أَثَرُ ٱلْكَيِّ.
verses.en: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim, it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar of the burning.
verses.kjv: And if the bright spot stay in his place, [and] spread not in the skin, but it [be] somewhat dark; it [is] a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it [is] an inflammation of the burning.
verses.web: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

verses.he: וְאִישׁ֙ אֹ֣ו אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בֹ֖ו נָ֑גַע בְּרֹ֖אשׁ אֹ֥ו בְזָקָֽן׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَ رَجُلٌ أَوِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ فِيهِ ضَرْبَةٌ فِي ٱلرَّأْسِ أَوْ فِي ٱلذَّقَنِ،
verses.en: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,
verses.kjv: ¶ If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.web: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָעֹ֔ור וּבֹ֛ו שֵׂעָ֥ר צָהֹ֖ב דָּ֑ק וְטִמֵּ֨א אֹתֹ֤ו הַכֹּהֵן֙ נֶ֣תֶק ה֔וּא צָרַ֧עַת הָרֹ֛אשׁ אֹ֥ו הַזָּקָ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَرَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلضَّرْبَةَ وَإِذَا مَنْظَرُهَا أَعْمَقُ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَفِيهَا شَعْرٌ أَشْقَرُ دَقِيقٌ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّهَا قَرَعٌ. بَرَصُ ٱلرَّأْسِ أَوِ ٱلذَّقَنِ.
verses.en: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it [be] in sight deeper than the skin; [and there be] in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a dry scall, [even] a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.web: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִרְאֶ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־נֶ֣גַע הַנֶּ֗תֶק וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵין־מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָעֹ֔ור וְשֵׂעָ֥ר שָׁחֹ֖ר אֵ֣ין בֹּ֑ו וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־נֶ֥גַע הַנֶּ֖תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِذَا رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ضَرْبَةَ ٱلْقَرَعِ وَإِذَا مَنْظَرُهَا لَيْسَ أَعْمَقَ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، لَكِنْ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَعْرٌ أَسْوَدُ، يَحْجُزُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْمَضْرُوبَ بِٱلْقَرَعِ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
verses.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days.
verses.kjv: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it [be] not in sight deeper than the skin, and [that there is] no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.web: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע֮ בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה בֹ֖ו שֵׂעָ֣ר צָהֹ֑ב וּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק אֵ֥ין עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָעֹֽור׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلضَّرْبَةَ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ وَإِذَا ٱلْقَرَعُ لَمْ يَمْتَدَّ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ شَعْرٌ أَشْقَرُ، وَلَا مَنْظَرُ ٱلْقَرَعِ أَعْمَقُ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ،
verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,
verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, [if] the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall [be] not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.web: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

verses.he: וְהִ֨תְגַּלָּ֔ח וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֖תֶק לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְהִסְגִּ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֧ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֛תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.ar: فَلْيَحْلِقْ. لَكِنْ لَا يَحْلِقِ ٱلْقَرَعَ. وَيَحْجُزُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْأَقْرَعَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ ثَانِيَةً.
verses.en: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more.
verses.kjv: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days more:
verses.web: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

verses.he: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֜תֶק בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙תֶק֙ בָּעֹ֔ור וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ אֵינֶ֥נּוּ עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָעֹ֑ור וְטִהַ֤ר אֹתֹו֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْأَقْرَعَ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ وَإِذَا ٱلْقَرَعُ لَمْ يَمْتَدَّ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، وَلَيْسَ مَنْظَرُهُ أَعْمَقَ مِنَ ٱلْجِلْدِ، يَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِطَهَارَتِهِ، فَيَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَكُونُ طَاهِرًا.
verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.kjv: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, [if] the scall be not spread in the skin, nor [be] in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.web: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֥ה יִפְשֶׂ֛ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּעֹ֑ור אַחֲרֵ֖י טָהֳרָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْقَرَعُ يَمْتَدُّ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ بَعْدَ ٱلْحُكْمِ بِطَهَارَتِهِ،
verses.en: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.kjv: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.web: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּעֹ֑ור לֹֽא־יְבַקֵּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לַשֵּׂעָ֥ר הַצָּהֹ֖ב טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَرَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلْقَرَعُ قَدِ ٱمْتَدَّ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، فَلَا يُفَتِّشُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَلَى ٱلشَّعْرِ ٱلْأَشْقَرِ. إِنَّهُ نَجِسٌ.
verses.en: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair: he is unclean.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he [is] unclean.
verses.web: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם־בְּעֵינָיו֩ עָמַ֨ד הַנֶּ֜תֶק וְשֵׂעָ֨ר שָׁחֹ֧ר צָֽמַח־בֹּ֛ו נִרְפָּ֥א הַנֶּ֖תֶק טָהֹ֣ור ה֑וּא וְטִהֲרֹ֖ו הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ ס
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ وَقَفَ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ وَنَبَتَ فِيهِ شَعْرٌ أَسْوَدُ، فَقَدْ بَرِئَ ٱلْقَرَعُ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ فَيَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِطَهَارَتِهِ.
verses.en: But if the scall stay in its appearance, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.kjv: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and [that] there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he [is] clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.web: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.he: וְאִישׁ֙ אֹֽו־אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְעֹור־בְּשָׂרָ֖ם בֶּהָרֹ֑ת בֶּהָרֹ֖ת לְבָנֹֽת׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَ رَجُلٌ أَوِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ لُمَعٌ، لُمَعٌ بِيضٌ،
verses.en: And if a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.kjv: ¶ If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, [even] white bright spots;
verses.web: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֧ה בְעֹור־בְּשָׂרָ֛ם בֶּהָרֹ֖ת כֵּהֹ֣ות לְבָנֹ֑ת בֹּ֥הַק ה֛וּא פָּרַ֥ח בָּעֹ֖ור טָהֹ֥ור הֽוּא׃ ס
verses.ar: وَرَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا فِي جِلْدِ جَسَدِهِ لُمَعٌ كَامِدَةُ ٱللَّوْنِ بَيْضَاءُ، فَذَلِكَ بَهَقٌ قَدْ أَفْرَخَ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ.
verses.en: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin: he is clean.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, [if] the bright spots in the skin of their flesh [be] darkish white; it [is] a freckled spot [that] groweth in the skin; he [is] clean.
verses.web: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשֹׁ֑ו קֵרֵ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָהֹ֥ור הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا كَانَ إِنْسَانٌ قَدْ ذَهَبَ شَعْرُ رَأْسِهِ فَهُوَ أَقْرَعُ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ.
verses.en: And if a man's hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.kjv: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he [is] bald; [yet is] he clean.
verses.web: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

verses.he: וְאִם֙ מִפְּאַ֣ת פָּנָ֔יו יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשֹׁ֑ו גִּבֵּ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָהֹ֥ור הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ ذَهَبَ شَعْرُ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ جِهَةِ وَجْهِهِ فَهُوَ أَصْلَعُ. إِنَّهُ طَاهِرٌ.
verses.en: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead-bald; yet is he clean.
verses.kjv: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he [is] forehead bald: [yet is] he clean.
verses.web: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בַקָּרַ֙חַת֙ אֹ֣ו בַגַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֙חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתֹּ֖ו אֹ֥ו בְגַבַּחְתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي ٱلْقَرَعَةِ أَوْ فِي ٱلصَّلْعَةِ ضَرْبَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ ضَارِبَةٌ إِلَى ٱلْحُمْرَةِ، فَهُوَ بَرَصٌ مُفْرِخٌ فِي قَرَعَتِهِ أَوْ فِي صَلْعَتِهِ.
verses.en: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.kjv: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it [is] a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.web: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה אֹתֹ֜ו הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֔מֶת בְּקָרַחְתֹּ֖ו אֹ֣ו בְגַבַּחְתֹּ֑ו כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה צָרַ֖עַת עֹ֥ור בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَآهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا نَاتِئُ ٱلضَّرْبَةِ أَبْيَضُ ضَارِبٌ إِلَى ٱلْحُمْرَةِ فِي قَرَعَتِهِ أَوْ فِي صَلْعَتِهِ، كَمَنْظَرِ ٱلْبَرَصِ فِي جِلْدِ ٱلْجَسَدِ،
verses.en: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh,
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, [if] the rising of the sore [be] white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.web: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

verses.he: אִישׁ־צָר֥וּעַ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא טַמֵּ֧א יְטַמְּאֶ֛נּוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בְּרֹאשֹׁ֥ו נִגְעֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَهُوَ إِنْسَانٌ أَبْرَصُ. إِنَّهُ نَجِسٌ. فَيَحْكُمُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ بِنَجَاسَتِهِ. إِنَّ ضَرْبَتَهُ فِي رَأْسِهِ.
verses.en: he is a leprous man, he is unclean; the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean: his plague is in his head.
verses.kjv: He is a leprous man, he [is] unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague [is] in his head.
verses.web: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

verses.he: וְהַצָּר֜וּעַ אֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֣ו הַנֶּ֗גַע בְּגָדָ֞יו יִהְי֤וּ פְרֻמִים֙ וְרֹאשֹׁו֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה פָר֔וּעַ וְעַל־שָׂפָ֖ם יַעְטֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א ׀ טָמֵ֖א יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْأَبْرَصُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ، تَكُونُ ثِيَابُهُ مَشْقُوقَةً، وَرَأْسُهُ يَكُونُ مَكْشُوفًا، وَيُغَطِّي شَارِبَيْهِ، وَيُنَادِي: نَجِسٌ، نَجِسٌ.
verses.en: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry: 'Unclean, unclean.'
verses.kjv: And the leper in whom the plague [is], his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.web: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

verses.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַנֶּ֥גַע בֹּ֛ו יִטְמָ֖א טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא בָּדָ֣ד יֵשֵׁ֔ב מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה מֹושָׁבֹֽו׃ ס
verses.ar: كُلَّ ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلَّتِي تَكُونُ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ فِيهِ يَكُونُ نَجِسًا. إِنَّهُ نَجِسٌ. يُقِيمُ وَحْدَهُ. خَارِجَ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ يَكُونُ مُقَامُهُ.
verses.en: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean; he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.
verses.kjv: All the days wherein the plague [shall be] in him he shall be defiled; he [is] unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp [shall] his habitation [be].
verses.web: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

verses.he: וְהַבֶּ֕גֶד כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בֹ֖ו נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת בְּבֶ֣גֶד צֶ֔מֶר אֹ֖ו בְּבֶ֥גֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.ar: «وَأَمَّا ٱلثَّوْبُ فَإِذَا كَانَ فِيهِ ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ، ثَوْبُ صُوفٍ أَوْ ثَوْبُ كَتَّانٍ،
verses.en: And when the plague of leprosy is in a garment, whether it be a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.kjv: ¶ The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, [whether it be] a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.web: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

verses.he: אֹ֤ו בִֽשְׁתִי֙ אֹ֣ו בְעֵ֔רֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּ֖ים וְלַצָּ֑מֶר אֹ֣ו בְעֹ֔ור אֹ֖ו בְּכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֹֽור׃
verses.ar: فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ مِنَ ٱلصُّوفِ أَوِ ٱلْكَتَّانِ، أَوْ فِي جِلْدٍ أَوْ فِي كُلِّ مَصْنُوعٍ مِنْ جِلْدٍ،
verses.en: or in the warp, or in the woof, whether they be of linen, or of wool; or in a skin, or in any thing made of skin.
verses.kjv: Whether [it be] in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.web: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

verses.he: וְהָיָ֨ה הַנֶּ֜גַע יְרַקְרַ֣ק ׀ אֹ֣ו אֲדַמְדָּ֗ם בַּבֶּגֶד֩ אֹ֨ו בָעֹ֜ור אֹֽו־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֹו־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ אֹ֣ו בְכָל־כְּלִי־עֹ֔ור נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְהָרְאָ֖ה אֶת־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَكَانَتِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ ضَارِبَةً إِلَى ٱلْخُضْرَةِ أَوْ إِلَى ٱلْحُمْرَةِ فِي ٱلثَّوْبِ أَوْ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ، فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ أَوْ فِي مَتَاعٍ مَا مِنْ جِلْدٍ، فَإِنَّهَا ضَرْبَةُ بَرَصٍ، فَتُعْرَضُ عَلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.en: If the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown unto the priest.
verses.kjv: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it [is] a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.web: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: فَيَرَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلضَّرْبَةَ وَيَحْجُزُ ٱلْمَضْرُوبَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up that which hath the plague seven days.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up [it that hath] the plague seven days:
verses.web: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־הַנֶּ֜גַע בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י כִּֽי־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֹֽו־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֹֽו־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ אֹ֣ו בָעֹ֔ור לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה הָעֹ֖ור לִמְלָאכָ֑ה צָרַ֧עַת מַמְאֶ֛רֶת הַנֶּ֖גַע טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: فَمَتَى رَأَى ٱلضَّرْبَةَ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ إِذَا كَانَتِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ قَدِ ٱمْتَدَّتْ فِي ٱلثَّوْبِ، فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ أَوْ فِي ٱلْجِلْدِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يُصْنَعُ مِنْ جِلْدٍ لِلْعَمَلِ، فَٱلضَّرْبَةُ بَرَصٌ مُفْسِدٌ. إِنَّهَا نَجِسَةٌ.
verses.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for, the plague is a malignant leprosy: it is unclean.
verses.kjv: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, [or] in any work that is made of skin; the plague [is] a fretting leprosy; it [is] unclean.
verses.web: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

verses.he: וְשָׂרַ֨ף אֶת־הַבֶּ֜גֶד אֹ֥ו אֶֽת־הַשְּׁתִ֣י ׀ אֹ֣ו אֶת־הָעֵ֗רֶב בַּצֶּ֙מֶר֙ אֹ֣ו בַפִּשְׁתִּ֔ים אֹ֚ו אֶת־כָּל־כְּלִ֣י הָעֹ֔ור אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה בֹ֖ו הַנָּ֑גַע כִּֽי־צָרַ֤עַת מַמְאֶ֙רֶת֙ הִ֔וא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.ar: فَيُحْرِقُ ٱلثَّوْبَ أَوِ ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةَ مِنَ ٱلصُّوفِ أَوِ ٱلْكَتَّانِ أَوْ مَتَاعِ ٱلْجِلْدِ ٱلَّذِي كَانَتْ فِيهِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ، لِأَنَّهَا بَرَصٌ مُفْسِدٌ. بِٱلنَّارِ يُحْرَقُ.
verses.en: And he shall burn the garment, or the warp, or the woof, whether it be of wool or of linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is; for it is a malignant leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.kjv: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it [is] a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.web: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

verses.he: וְאִם֮ יִרְאֶ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע בַּבֶּ֕גֶד אֹ֥ו בַשְּׁתִ֖י אֹ֣ו בָעֵ֑רֶב אֹ֖ו בְּכָל־כְּלִי־עֹֽור׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلضَّرْبَةُ لَمْ تَمْتَدَّ فِي ٱلثَّوْبِ فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ أَوْ فِي مَتَاعِ ٱلْجِلْدِ،
verses.en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.kjv: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.web: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

verses.he: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִ֨בְּס֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֖ו הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּירֹ֥ו שִׁבְעַת־יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.ar: يَأْمُرُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ أَنْ يَغْسِلُوا مَا فِيهِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ، وَيَحْجُزُهُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ ثَانِيَةً.
verses.en: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall command that they wash [the thing] wherein the plague [is], and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.web: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֣י ׀ הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹֽא־הָפַ֨ךְ הַנֶּ֤גַע אֶת־עֵינֹו֙ וְהַנֶּ֣גַע לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֔ה טָמֵ֣א ה֔וּא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֑נּוּ פְּחֶ֣תֶת הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתֹּ֖ו אֹ֥ו בְגַבַּחְתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ بَعْدَ غَسْلِ ٱلْمَضْرُوبِ وَإِذَا ٱلضَّرْبَةُ لَمْ تُغَيِّرْ مَنْظَرَهَا، وَلَا ٱمْتَدَّتِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ، فَهُوَ نَجِسٌ. بِٱلنَّارِ تُحْرِقُهُ. إِنَّهَا نُخْرُوبٌ فِي جُرْدَةِ بَاطِنِهِ أَوْ ظَاهِرِهِ.
verses.en: And the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its colour, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, [if] the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it [is] unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it [is] fret inward, [whether] it [be] bare within or without.
verses.web: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

verses.he: וְאִם֮ רָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע אַחֲרֵ֖י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֹתֹ֑ו וְקָרַ֣ע אֹתֹ֗ו מִן־הַבֶּ֙גֶד֙ אֹ֣ו מִן־הָעֹ֔ור אֹ֥ו מִן־הַשְּׁתִ֖י אֹ֥ו מִן־הָעֵֽרֶב׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ رَأَى ٱلْكَاهِنُ وَإِذَا ٱلضَّرْبَةُ كَامِدَةُ ٱللَّوْنِ بَعْدَ غَسْلِهِ، يُمَزِّقُهَا مِنَ ٱلثَّوْبِ أَوِ ٱلْجِلْدِ مِنَ ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ.
verses.en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof.
verses.kjv: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague [be] somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.web: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

verses.he: וְאִם־תֵּרָאֶ֨ה עֹ֜וד בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֹֽו־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֹֽו־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ אֹ֣ו בְכָל־כְּלִי־עֹ֔ור פֹּרַ֖חַת הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֣שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֖ו הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنْ ظَهَرَتْ أَيْضًا فِي ٱلثَّوْبِ فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ أَوْ فِي مَتَاعِ ٱلْجِلْدِ فَهِيَ مُفْرِخَةٌ. بِٱلنَّارِ تُحْرِقُ مَا فِيهِ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ.
verses.en: And if it appear still in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, it is breaking out, thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.kjv: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it [is] a spreading [plague:] thou shalt burn that wherein the plague [is] with fire.
verses.web: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

verses.he: וְהַבֶּ֡גֶד אֹֽו־הַשְּׁתִ֨י אֹו־הָעֵ֜רֶב אֹֽו־כָל־כְּלִ֤י הָעֹור֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּכַבֵּ֔ס וְסָ֥ר מֵהֶ֖ם הַנָּ֑גַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס שֵׁנִ֖ית וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلثَّوْبُ، ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةُ أَوْ مَتَاعُ ٱلْجِلْدِ ٱلَّذِي تَغْسِلُهُ وَتَزُولُ مِنْهُ ٱلضَّرْبَةُ، فَيُغْسَلُ ثَانِيَةً فَيَطْهُرُ.
verses.en: And the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.kjv: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin [it be], which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.web: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

verses.he: זֹ֠את תֹּורַ֨ת נֶֽגַע־צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַצֶּ֣מֶר ׀ אֹ֣ו הַפִּשְׁתִּ֗ים אֹ֤ו הַשְּׁתִי֙ אֹ֣ו הָעֵ֔רֶב אֹ֖ו כָּל־כְּלִי־עֹ֑ור לְטַהֲרֹ֖ו אֹ֥ו לְטַמְּאֹֽו׃ פ
verses.ar: «هَذِهِ شَرِيعَةُ ضَرْبَةِ ٱلْبَرَصِ فِي ٱلصُّوفِ أَوِ ٱلْكَتَّانِ، فِي ٱلسَّدَى أَوِ ٱللُّحْمَةِ أَوْ فِي كُلِّ مَتَاعٍ مِنْ جِلْدٍ، لِلْحُكْمِ بِطَهَارَتِهِ أَوْ نَجَاسَتِهِ».
verses.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.kjv: This [is] the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.web: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
